mostWorthwhile.text: Following weathered basalt into two different forms of transport was most worthwhile: dissolved ions and suspended solids behave differently.

leastWorthwhile.text: The transport steps felt somewhat repetitive, especially after runoff had already carried dissolved material toward the sea.

surprise.text: Clear-looking runoff can carry rock-derived ions, whereas cloudiness comes from suspended solid particles.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though most steps had only one offered combination, so the route was largely prescribed.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the distinction between dissolved and solid material made the natural processes clear, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
